==================

The Connetic Account-to-Account organization owns high-value payment processing, instant payment processing and batch payment processing end to end. **What You'll Own**
===================

* Own delivery across two or more teams for instant payments and high-value payments, reporting to you directly or through other managers or leads
* Lead and grow multiple teams of 7-12 full-time engineers each: hire, onboard, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and create a climate where people are motivated to do their best work, not just show up. Overall span of control may extend beyond this range once contractor staff augmentation is factored in
* Coach and develop your engineers' careers — identifying growth opportunities, giving direct feedback, and mentoring the team through technical and professional challenges
* Own delivery and quality trends across your teams — aggregate deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and MTTR, and drive the fixes a single team can't solve alone
* Own reliability outcomes across your teams — set the incident response and postmortem standards your managers follow, and step in personally on the most severe or cross-team incidents
* Stay technically credible across multiple codebases or domains: participate in architecture reviews at a higher altitude, and know when to go deep versus trust your team members' judgment
* Drive AI adoption across multiple teams — set targets, track adoption and impact, and share what's working across the teams you lead
* Advise your senior engineers on moderately complex technical and people matters, without doing their job for them
* Modify and execute policies that affect your area of the organization, and recommend changes that should apply more broadly
* Communicate regularly with senior and peer leadership on matters spanning several teams, functions, or customers
* Own budget and headcount planning for your area, balancing near-term delivery against longer-term investment

**Our Tech Stack**
==================

*You don't need full hands-on competency in this stack, but you should be fluent enough to review designs, make staffing calls, and comfortable enough to earn credibility with the team building on it.*

* Java / Spring for backend and Angular for frontend — enough depth to evaluate trade-offs across multiple codebases and coach your team on technical judgment
* Gen AI / LLM tooling — fluent enough to set adoption strategy and evaluate tool or vendor choices across multiple teams
* Low-latency systems — familiar enough to guide design decisions and set the technical bar across teams working on transaction processing or high-throughput systems
* Microservices & APIs — solid enough grounding to review cross-team architecture decisions and API contracts
* Containers & Kubernetes — working knowledge sufficient to evaluate infrastructure decisions across multiple teams
* Cloud platforms — working familiarity with Azure; exposure to AWS a plus
* CI/CD & DevOps — comfortable evaluating pipeline standards across teams, not just one

**What You Bring**
==================

*You don't need to check every box below to apply — if most of this resonates, we want to hear from you.*

* 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years managing other managers, tech leads, or multiple teams directly
* Strong critical thinking applied across a broader, less clearly-defined set of problems — you're comfortable when principles alone don't fully apply
* Strong systems thinking across multiple teams' systems, spotting where complexity crosses team boundaries
* Solid grounding in SaaS and cloud-native fundamentals, applied at a multi-team level
* Genuine curiosity that drives you to dig into problems that don't have a strategic direction yet
* A track record of leading through other leaders — developing managers and senior ICs, not just individual engineers
* Strong understanding of software architecture across multiple systems or domains
* Working familiarity with major cloud platforms, container orchestration, and CI/CD at a multi-team scale
* A track record of using AI-assisted engineering as a lever across a broader organization
* Demonstrated ability to persuade senior stakeholders in sensitive or complex situations while preserving relationships
* Excellent communication with executives, peers, and the teams several levels below you

**Bonus Points**
================

* Experience in payments, financial services, or another regulated industry
* Experience managing distributed or remote teams across multiple time zones
* A track record of turning around an underperforming team or function
* Experience owning a departmental budget

**What We Offer**
=================

* Lead engineering for a platform processing mission-critical payment transactions for financial institutions worldwide
* Be part of a truly global product development organization — real centers of engineering excellence spread across multiple regions, organized around product families and technical capabilities rather than geography for its own sake, with engineers everywhere shaping our core products and technical direction
* A cloud-native, automation-first engineering culture that treats quality, security, and developer experience as competitive advantages, not compliance checkboxes
* Real leadership growth — ACI actively develops managers into senior engineering leaders; your trajectory here is yours to define
* An organization that holds managers accountable for AI adoption outcomes, not just tool advocacy — you'll have real latitude to drive that
* Hybrid model — typically 2–3 days in-office across ACI's global hub locations
* Some domestic and international travel (10–15%) for team meetings, conferences, or cross-site collaboration
* Flexible schedule, with occasional extended hours around critical releases or team needs

**Equal Opportunity & Compliance**
----------------------------------

ACI Worldwide is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. This role requires adherence to ACI's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and — given access to sensitive payment data — compliance with applicable security and data-protection standards (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA). Comprehensive background screening is required. Responsibilities may evolve with business needs.

You will work directly with Finance and Global Business Services leaders worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. Success is measured by adoption, demonstrable business outcomes (time saved, quality, risk, controls, cycle time, better decisions, financial impact) and how much of your work others reuse.

The role needs regular overlap with US and European time zones, including some early-evening IST calls, and can be demanding at times, including period-end close support and leading the response to production incidents. ==================

----------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------
